delivery: Complete static snapshots plus new investigations; not a deployed commercial platform

tasks.title: Establish the canonical site and test baseline
tasks.scope: Inventory every activity and helper, compare Puzzles/J/K and prior ZIPs, record canonical versions, preserve backups and create an activity manifest. Use this ZIP as a starting snapshot, not an assumed complete history.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every menu target resolves; every activity has an owner/path/status; duplicate versions and exclusions are documented.

tasks.title: Desktop and phone smoke tests for every activity
tasks.scope: Open every page in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari where available. Test Android/iOS portrait and landscape, small screens, keyboard, touch, reduced motion, reset and saved state. Record reproducible bugs by URL and action.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Evidence matrix with pass/fail; no broken launch, trapped input or missing primary controls.

tasks.title: Mastermind board, timing and statistics audit
tasks.scope: Audit compact timer on/off with count-up/countdown options, no undo, previous guesses visible on phones, show solution at timeout, remaining-combination option per guess. Keep settings-specific session/overall and timed/untimed records, local profiles, clear controls, hints, unfinished and timeout counts. Define treatment of failures without disguising them as solved means.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Synthetic games verify all statistics and persistence. Solved-only averages are labelled; timeout counts and completion rate remain visible; timer settings and scores stay compact at bottom.

tasks.title: Dobble investigation and gameplay stability
tasks.scope: New builder, pair tests, custom labels, print/export and prime-grid extensions supplied. Audit original solo/play pages, input races, shuffle validity, reset, touch and completion. Add reversible edits and intelligible feedback. Do not expose Fano construction at the start.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every pair in valid decks shares one symbol; invalid and incomplete decks receive correct feedback; no double scoring; mobile printed cards usable.

tasks.title: Creature Studio and complete teaching sessions
tasks.scope: New page and session sheet supplied. Notebooks worm1.nb/worm2.nb inspected; 3:2 golden-ratio-scaled loop added. Validate drawing, motion, constant-distance spacing, save/load and fixed camera. Offer practical and deeper paths without arithmetic speed becoming the entry barrier.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Jamie-style design-first and Kai-style reasoning sessions piloted; malformed files cannot corrupt state; touch route drawing and pause/step work on actual devices.

tasks.title: Escher-inspired spiral and transformation investigation
tasks.scope: Original nested gallery, logarithmic unwrap and complex-power grid supplied. It is not an exact Print Gallery reconstruction. Improve touch manipulation, mathematical labels and progression. Keep advanced material optional.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Identity map and branch handling verified; transformations explained accurately; primary experience understandable without complex numbers.

tasks.title: String Lab, Curve Lab and reflection physics
tasks.scope: Root String Lab paths corrected. Audit every nails/hyperbola/saddle/tower page, prevent misleading naming of parabolic envelopes as hyperbolas, and retain construction recipes. Test brachistochrone, joined coordinate points and ramp timers; ellipse shots should pot only under valid focus geometry/tolerance; add straight-sided reflection, projectiles and conic sections as separate investigations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Path links and geometry verified; fixed camera; no false potting; phone plotting and drag interactions reliable.

tasks.title: Painted cubes, factors, Euclid and packing stability
tasks.scope: Preserve 6³/7³, blue-only default, movable spread slider default 0, buckets remain at end, single clear autosort control. Check cube classification counts and paced inspection. Audit factor tree colour rules; factor-shape sliders encourage discovery; Euclid take-away grid fits without shaking. Keep rejected cube-challenges off menus.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Correct combinatorial counts and sorting; touch controls stable; no answers revealed prematurely; mathematical claims distinguish exact algorithms from conjecture.

tasks.title: Construction, coding and manipulation stability
tasks.scope: Audit bridge from scratch with examples and clear failure animation; Sprouts legal moves; Robot Trails locking jigsaw commands, compact consistent controls, facing robot, isometric labels/fixed plot. Keep Code Grid tap-to-build Python-style commands with visible loop extent. Improve polyomino touch rotate/flip without losing piece.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No stuck drawing or disappearing pieces; keyboard/touch alternatives; every challenge solvable and resettable.

tasks.title: River crossing and remaining activity audit
tasks.scope: Improve existing boat/animal animation without whole redesign: cargo visible, wave motion, natural child-friendly consequences without munch text. Check goat/wolf/lettuce constraints/extensions, money-plant day phases and repeated clicks, scytale wrapping/text alignment/unwrapping/zoom, Josephus cards A–K in circle and other catalogue games.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No duplicated day advancement or invalid crossings; animations reveal state accurately; each activity has a practical investigation prompt.

tasks.title: Shared visual design system and master pages
tasks.scope: Commission or develop 3–5 representative master pages: homepage/library, puzzle board, simulation, exercise, parent/admin. Keep Orbital default and all three themes. Large useful play area, concise instructions, accessible controls, undo icon where appropriate. Use polished playful design references as inspiration, not copied artwork.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design tokens, spacing, responsive rules and component states approved on phones/tablets/desktops before site-wide rollout.

tasks.title: Apply design system and accessibility checks
tasks.scope: Migrate components systematically with screenshots and regression checks. Check contrast, keyboard focus, touch target size, motion preference, screen-reader names and colour-independent information. Avoid text-heavy instructions and reward clutter.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All activity templates pass agreed accessibility and device checklist; visual changes do not change mathematical behaviour.

tasks.title: Curriculum and theme catalogue
tasks.scope: Draft Year 4 crosswalk and all-age routes exist in platform pilot. Align original activities to England KS1–5 official objectives and current White Rose sequence as a reference. Separate prerequisite, accessible entry, extension depth, topic, age guide and confidence. Review uploaded Y3/Y4 and own questions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every mapping is sourced, dated and reviewed; theme-first browse can narrow by stage, topic or prerequisite; no copying of proprietary worksheet collections.

tasks.title: Personalised homeschool pathways and goals
tasks.scope: Create essentials and deeper routes, flexible pace, learner/parent goals and review dates; practical experiments plus optional consolidation. Tutor sessions may assign practice as homework with parent notes; consider a parent session every two months.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Users can choose a goal, see prerequisites, adapt route and revisit learning without age-based lockout.

tasks.title: Original generated consolidation and auto-marking
tasks.scope: 14 practice families in platform pilot. Extend each taught topic with examples, fading support, diagrams and printable versions. Visualise constraints; avoid leaked answers. Mark equivalent numerical forms and record hints/attempts separately.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Generator test corpus verifies validity, answer equivalence and level controls; parents can access guidance; learner answers remain hidden until appropriate.

tasks.title: Tracking and assessment model
tasks.scope: Define evidence of strengths/difficulties: independent attempts, hints, strategy explanation, revisions, fluency, transfer and engagement. Log only necessary data with retention decisions. Distinguish exploration from testing and avoid equating speed with ability.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Event schema, test data and educator dashboard are reviewed; progress claims trace to observed evidence and context.

tasks.title: Draft reports and support recommendations
tasks.scope: Generate educator-reviewed reports with uncertainty, strengths, next steps and examples. SEND recommendations should be educational supports with human review, not automated diagnosis. Record intervention, rationale, review date and observed response.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No report sent without authorised review; every statement has supporting evidence; edit/export workflow and correction process work.

tasks.title: Choose hosting and authentication architecture
tasks.scope: Python/SQLite local pilot supplied separately. Choose production stack and deployment ownership deliberately. GitHub Pages cannot execute this server. Decide parent-managed child accounts, password reset, tenant separation, sessions, backups, audit logging and migration.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Architecture decision record, staging environment, backup/restore drill and threat model; no security based on hidden menu links.

tasks.title: Passwords, accounts and secure recovery
tasks.scope: Pilot has password hashing, sessions, CSRF and rate limiting. Harden with independent review, password recovery, administrator protection, revocation and account lifecycle. Do not claim the pilot is production secure.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Authentication tests cover account enumeration, abuse, expired tokens, session revocation and recovery; deployment settings reviewed.

tasks.title: Admin lockability and personalised access
tasks.scope: Pilot supports per-learner activity/topic permissions and parent linking. Expand to groups, schedules, tutor/parent roles, preview-as-learner and immutable permission audit. Restrict protected content at server/API level.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Direct URL/API access denied when locked; unrelated families/tutors isolated; policy changes take effect promptly; admin can see exactly what each learner sees.

tasks.title: Move activities into protected platform
tasks.scope: One canonical activity source with personalised menus, not separate manually maintained J/K codebases. Keep static export for demos. Migrate saved progress/settings with consent and versioned schemas. Client-delivered code cannot be made impossible to copy.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Chosen pilot games available behind real access checks; old content backed up; no broken deep links; migration reversible.

tasks.title: Online tuition chat and shared gameplay
tasks.scope: Private text rooms and server-validated two-player Mastermind exist in pilot. Add reconnect tests, accessible chat, moderation/close controls and clear retention. Consider voice/video via an appropriate established service. Test secret-state handling and simultaneous inputs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only room members can read/write; guesses cannot leak secrets; reconnect resumes safely; tutor can pause/end; family settings enforced.

tasks.title: Subscriptions, entitlement and commercial accounts
tasks.scope: Choose payment provider, tiers, free demonstrations and parent purchasing flow. Server verifies payment notifications and entitlements. Define cancellation, refunds, failed payments and content access. Consider school licences and workshop bookings separately.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sandbox purchase/cancel/refund tested end to end; no card data stored by this app; permissions match verified entitlement.

tasks.title: Privacy, rights, safeguarding and legal review
tasks.scope: Obtain current professional review for child data, consent/account model, chat safeguarding, retention/deletion, commercial terms and accessibility. Maintain provenance/licensing for ideas, code, images and curriculum references; distinguish inspiration from reproduction.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Written review actions closed before public commercial pilot; deletion/export and incident process tested.

tasks.title: Small tutoring and homeschool pilots
tasks.scope: Start with existing tutoring use and parent feedback, then small homeschool workshops. Measure usability, willingness to return, explanation/transfer and practical-screen balance. Separate service evaluation from formal research; obtain relevant approvals before recruitment/data collection.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Predefined questions/measures; baseline and follow-up evidence; negative outcomes and disengagement reported; design decisions linked to findings.

tasks.title: School pilots and educator training
tasks.scope: Pilot class use and staff training with varied teachers. Test whether materials support learning without depending on exceptional delivery. Develop INSET, lesson guides, cheap resource packs and workshop model; hire skilled educators as capacity grows.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Feasibility, workload, accessibility and learning evidence collected across more than one context; training materials revised from observation.

tasks.title: Business model, partners and launch plan
tasks.scope: Compare tutoring aide, homeschool subscription, workshops, school licensing and educator training before government contracts. Cost hosting, support, content and design; test willingness to pay. Explore appropriate YouTuber partnerships and local contacts. Keep ed-psych practice/research boundaries explicit if that career route develops.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Costed model with assumptions, achievable capacity, pilot conversion data and go/no-go thresholds; contracts reviewed before sale.

tasks.title: Commercial release and ongoing operations
tasks.scope: Release in stages with monitoring, backups, restore drills, incident handling, customer support, accessibility feedback and scheduled maintenance. Maintain staging and production; avoid deploying untested AI-wide changes.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Release checklist signed off, rollback tested, support ownership assigned, monitoring and regular access review operational.

tasks.title: Future investigations and content backlog
tasks.scope: Proof-writing interactives; balance-scale algebra; partitioning multiplication/division; KS2 essentials; circle theorems, trig, statistics, mechanics, calculus; GCSE/A-level/Olympiad worked questions; practical numbers, weights, codes/Enigma/RSA/one-time pads; minesweeper including higher-dimensional/probability extensions; world-building/influencer model; finite planes; computational packing and Mathematica algorithms. Build, test, select/reject, deepen the good ones.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each new activity has a mathematical objective, practical counterpart where suitable, prerequisite, exploratory task, verification and educator notes.
